Mark, Rebe & the mountain

From the islands to the plateau.

Mark Claunch was a licensed tattooer in Hawaii before he was one in Enumclaw. That's where the 808 number comes from, and the Aloha.

The shop

Mustard walls and a red counter.

His work has carried the Claunch Ink name since 2009. Today it lives in a shop with mustard walls, a red counter, a skeleton on the wall and hand-painted signs. Rebe handles the piercing chair. Between them, the reviews read like a small town that found its spot.

This August they took the shop on the road to a booth in Seattle. The shirt says the rest: Bigfoot, a plaid shirt, a shaka. Sasquatch meets Aloha.

MMark ClaunchTattoos · @claunchinktattoo RRebePiercing · @mountpeakbodypiercing
